title: factory.json — global kernel config (P2.3)
description: The kernel's one config file. P2.3 makes the sandbox well-defined: the only implemented isolation is 'process', where adapter subprocesses get a sanitized environment (env_allowlist, case-insensitive names, prefix wildcards ending in '*'; the FACTORY_* prefix is kernel-reserved) and, with strict_cwd, run from the job worktree instead of the adapter directory. network_allowlist and resource_limits are declared here and enforced in later slices; a schema-valid config never implies an already-implemented enforcement.

default_mode.description: Mode for new projects that do not name one.

price_table.description: Per-tier per-million-token rates (same shape as price_table.schema.json, which remains the authoritative schema for this section).

type.description: In-process subprocess isolation: sanitized env + controlled cwd. 'container' lands only with real implementation.

env_allowlist.description: Environment variables adapter subprocesses may keep: exact names (case-insensitive match) or prefix wildcards ending in '*' (e.g. 'FACTORY_*'; the lone '*' keeps everything and is an explicit opt-out). Absent at runtime: the kernel's documented default allowlist applies.

strict_cwd.description: When true, adapter subprocesses run with cwd set to the job's worktree instead of the adapter directory. Absent: false (back-compat).

network_allowlist.description: Hostnames the sandbox should restrict adapters to. Declared here since P0; enforcement is still future (do not mistake this list for a working firewall).

resource_limits.description: Declared ceilings for one attempt. Enforced by the per-stage 'minutes' timeout today; the rest is future.

risk_scoring.description: Same shape as risk.schema.json, which remains the authoritative schema for this section (P2.4). The band-to-action mapping is kernel-owned: configuration re-weights the score, it never decides what a band does. Absent: the kernel's documented defaults apply.
